comments.body: @HannaTuerk @askhl Ok I think I have done what was intended. Any thoughts?

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body:
Hey @ajjackson , thanks for implementing this. I think it does not make sense to have the possibility to give additional axis keywords with the 'ax_'parameters in case we turn of the axis anyways. This is very confusing as many properties that are set e.g., axis labels will not be displayed in case the axis is turned off.
I suggest we either:
-  get rid of this additional feature since one can pass in an axis and modify everything else outside of ase or
- we need to provide a flag to turn off of the axis within the function (with default False to avoid confusion where labels went).

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: I agree it would be simpler not to have this. And for tutorial purposes it is probably better to show people the "normal way" of fine-tuning Matplotlib plots.

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body:
ok, then let's remove this. Do you want to or shall I?
I will add an issue for to add a tutorial on the intended usage of these functions on the tutorial milestone for now

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: While removing `ax_parameters` I also changed some `**parameters` to `**kwargs`. If people have strong opinions about that I won't resist changing back; it just seemed more idiomatic...
